clips.title: The story
paras: A Warsong scout keeps watch along eastern Ashenvale’s perilous paths. Warsong Outrider Update carries intelligence about nearby Alliance forces, entrenched satyr, and naga moving through neighboring Azshara.

A lone Warsong Outrider watches the contested eastern edge of Ashenvale. Horde supply lines face constant harassment here, so the outriders scout enemy movements before raiding parties can strike Mor'shan Rampart or Splintertree Post. Meeting one on patrol means the forest is under watch, and the report he carries may help decide whether a Horde fortification holds or falls to ambush.

A Warsong Outrider’s report describes danger across Kalimdor’s central forests. Night elves and the wider Alliance remain a threat, while cunning, demonic satyr haunt eastern Ashenvale. Scouts have also found a massive naga presence spreading through the ruined coastal lands of neighboring Azshara. The Horde faces hostile powers from almost every direction.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Much danger lies along this path, friend. You'd do best to remember this while traveling in these lands. The threat of the alliance is quite near.
We are faced by enemies on all fronts. The satyr are a formidable and prevalent force in eastern Ashenvale. I have also discovered that the naga have taken over a large area of the land of Azshara.
It's good to see that we are still bolstering our numbers -- be ready for what lies ahead, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Take my update to Kadrak. Swiftly, friend.
